intro.title: 8va
intro.text: “8va” with a dashed line means: play these notes an octave (8 notes) higher than written. It saves a stack of ledger lines. Bars 3–4 look like bars 1–2 but sound an octave up.

intro.title: 8vb
intro.text: “8vb” under the staff means an octave lower. In bars 7–8 the left hand plays down near the bottom of your keyboard.
